atom_definition: dimension plus canonical material value from frozen SemanticSignature; NOT_APPLICABLE dimensions emit no atom
full_signature: ordered applicable atoms hashed with SHA-256
complete_signature: frozen SQL parses under the M11.0R bounded parser and yields all supported fields
incomplete_signature: parse failure or unsupported/ambiguous bounded shape
unique_full_signature: no other target has the same full signature hash
all_atoms_reused: every atom appears in at least one other target
novel_atom_target: at least one atom has frequency one
compositionally_novel_target: unique full signature and every atom is reused elsewhere
